tools.name: get_page_info
tools.description: Get metadata about the current page including title, description, URL, language, and main content as text.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate to a page on the Treyd website by path. Use paths like "/blog", "/about", or language-prefixed paths like "/sv/blog".

path.description: The URL path to navigate to, e.g. "/blog" or "/sv/about"

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search for content on the Treyd website. Returns matching text from the sitemap or current page content.

query.description: The search term to look for on the site
